notes: KILN now floats closer to the commander in the early levels, and its glow is bigger so it reads the same size as in level 5.
Level 3: the camp wall no longer touches the rock piles behind it, so builders can always walk around the back.
Sela's arrival: the film ends as she steps out of her buggy. It stays parked at the camp's east entrance with its lights on, and she walks in from it. No more driverless buggy rolling beside her.
